title: Initialize Next.js Website + Homepage
goal: Create public-facing property website with Next.js 16, Tailwind, Framer Motion. Build animated homepage.
result_summary: Created Next.js 16 + App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind website. Homepage has: animated Hero with search bar (buy/rent toggle + location input), FeaturedProperties grid with placeholder data, StatsCounter with animated number counting, CTA section for Panditji WhatsApp, responsive Navbar with mobile menu, Footer with quick links. Dark modern theme with Framer Motion animations. Price formatting in INR (Lakh/Crore).
